algorithm.title: Recommendations for Postexposure Prophylaxis of Nonhealth Care Personnel.

cell.label: Contraindications to vaccine or at increased risk for severe disease or complications?a
Use VZIG/VariZIG, up to 96 h postexposure (best if <72 h).
If not contraindicated, wait 5 months p VZIG to vaccinate.
Type of report?
cell.path: Parental/self report of history of varicella
Laboratory or physician-documented history of varicella

cell.label: Vaccination recommended within 3–5 days of exposure.

footnotes.footnote: a Includes: pregnant women without evidence of immunity, immunocompromised persons, premature neonates, neonates whose mothers show symptoms 5 days before to 2 days after delivery.
